parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the SSL server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the SSL server. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL server belongs.

The SSL server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the [DescribeVpnGateway](~~2794055~~) operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance.

parameters.name: SslVpnServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL server.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.
